name: codex-run-budget
description: Shared token governance, native account quota sensing, and recent-task telemetry for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Native quotas, tokens and lifecycle diagnostics.
interface.longDescription: Adds shared token governance and lifecycle diagnostics. Native quota sensing records account percentages and reset windows separately from local model tokens and backend-estimated credits, without inventing per-model quota allocations or changing budgets.
defaultPrompt: Start a 100k shared run budget for this task.
Survey recent tasks for model tokens and lifecycle evidence.
Sense native Codex quota percentages and compare saved observations with local model tokens.
